subject: general
question: Who was the head of the committee of the Draft National Education Policy (NEP) 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K Kasturirangan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **K Kasturirangan** is an eminent Indian space scientist who played a key role in formulating the Draft National Education Policy (NEP) 2019.
 
• He was the chairman of the committee responsible for drafting the NEP 2019, which aims to reform and revitalize the Indian education system.
 
• Under his leadership, the committee focused on making education more holistic, flexible, multidisciplinary, aligned with the needs of the 21st century, and aimed at bringing out the unique capabilities of each student.
 
• K Kasturirangan has also served as the former chairman of ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) and has been awarded several prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2019:**

 
 
• The NEP 2019 is a comprehensive framework to guide the development of education in the country. It covers elementary to higher education in both rural and urban India.
 
• The policy emphasizes the importance of early childhood care and education (ECCE), foundational literacy and numeracy, and the overall development of students.
 
• It proposes a new curricular structure, which includes a 5+3+3+4 design, corresponding to the ages 3-8 years (Foundational Stage), 8-11 (Preparatory Stage), 11-14 (Middle Stage), and 14-18 (Secondary Stage).
 
• The policy also focuses on teacher education and training, setting up a National Higher Education Regulatory Authority (NHERA), and promoting the use of technology in education.
 
 
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation):**
 
 
• ISRO is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• Its primary objective is to advance space technology and use its applications for various national tasks.
 
• ISRO has successfully launched several important missions, including Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, and various satellite launches.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, categorized into three levels: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• These awards are given in various disciplines/fields such as art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, and civil service.
